purpose: Establish shared creative direction; never establish product truth or launch permission.

editorial_guidelines.tone: Use the retrieved PMM voice, adapted to this channel; no fixed writing script.
guidance: Keep objectives within the selected supported task; do not invent performance targets or measured outcomes.
Synthesize existing PMM guidance. Mark audience motivations as hypotheses, not demonstrated consumer research.
Give three coherent messaging pillars, supported by scoped product evidence; keep hypothetical positioning distinct.
Report operational restrictions and unknowns without changing or approving them. Source permissions remain application-owned.

review_criteria: Campaign direction is usable across all four channels and consistent with PMM guidance.
Audience hypotheses and positioning proposals are distinguishable from factual product assertions.
Pillars, CTA and reported restrictions agree with the current authorized research context.
